items.q: Whose turn is it to do the watering this week?

items.answer: Cut back the boundary hedge; Clear the drainage ditch; Return the borrowed rotavator; Renew the public liability insurance

items.q: What does Priya need to do before the committee meeting on Thursday 18 March?
items.answer: Priya needs to book the skip for the clear-out by Wednesday 17 March (the permit has come through) and finish sending round the AGM minutes by Thursday 18 March (the draft is done).

items.q: Is anything waiting on the council? If so, what?
items.answer: Yes — “Fix the main gate lock” is waiting on the Council’s estates team, and “Get the water meter replaced” is waiting on the council, with the visit not booked yet.
